name: Content Review
summary: Request changes or decide approval for a specific revision of content.
overview: A service sends content for review. The recipient can submit feedback or decide whether to approve the revision they received. A proposed approval may require an authorized human decision and ends as approved, declined, stale or expired. Editing the draft and sending or publishing it remain separate service operations.
target: Service-owned content identified by its exact revision.

operations.name: Request changes
operations.description: Record feedback on the identified revision.

operations.name: Approve
operations.description: Propose or record approval of that revision.

inputs: The target revision and, for a change request, review feedback.
results: Feedback recorded; approval recorded; or a proposed approval closed as declined, stale or expired. Every result identifies the request and exact revision.
permissions: The service checks permission when the request is proposed and again when a human decides it. An authorized teammate may decide for the same service tenant. An unauthorized attempt does not change the proposed request. Editing and any later sending or publication require their own permissions.
humanRoute: A review page showing the same content and revision.

example.title: Review a campaign draft
steps: The service emails a review request for revision 3 of a campaign.
A reviewer asks for a timezone to be added to the opening paragraph.
The service records the feedback. An editor prepares revision 4.
The reviewer approves revision 4 and the service records that decision.
example.exception: An approval request for revision 3 is refused once that revision is stale. Approval of revision 4 does not send the campaign.

history.label: 0.2 · Working draft
history.description: Declares completed and terminal failed outcomes for supervised approval, including declined, stale and expired decisions. Human decisions are authorized independently of the proposing client.
